confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July rates vary widely by location, booking lead time and property. Cocktail and wine anchors are roughly in line with the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Figures assume about 1.15 USD per EUR.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a mid-sized Mediterranean resort town on Cyprus's southwest coast. Price levels are benchmarked against other Cypriot and southern European resort towns with similar summer tourism, with Limassol as the main reference point for restaurant prices and Paphos accommodation kept somewhat below it.
